title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
summary: Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren, and Jian Sun submitted "Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition" to arXiv on December 10, 2015. The paper presents a residual-learning framework that reformulates network layers as learning residual functions with reference to layer inputs and reports experiments with residual networks up to 152 layers on ImageNet.
significance: A documented deep-learning milestone for residual-learning architectures, recorded from the authors' arXiv submission and Microsoft Research's publication record for the later CVPR 2016 paper.
